name: official-embed
about: A platform's own embed in a site-templates slot (site-kit#380): Instagram first, a profile or a post, as the markup Instagram gives (its blockquote and embed.js), with a plain link inside the blockquote that shows when the script can't load. The URL is checked to the platform's own host and paths, every value is attribute-escaped, and there is no inline script. The README gives the exact _headers block that scopes the page's CSP to the platform's hosts. YouTube (site-kit#573): a facade of a site-local poster, a play button and a plain link; nothing goes to YouTube until the click, which swaps in a youtube-nocookie.com iframe.
